title: ServiceM8 vs Jobber (2026): Per-Job vs Per-User Pricing
description: ServiceM8 vs Jobber: job-credit plans with unlimited users vs per-user pricing. Cost for 1-10 people, card fees, routing and QuickBooks, from vendor pages.
h1: ServiceM8 vs Jobber: which pricing model costs less?
body:
ServiceM8 and Jobber price in opposite ways. ServiceM8 charges by how many new jobs you create each month and gives every paid plan unlimited users. Jobber charges by how many people use the account and its pricing page lists no job limit. Which one costs less depends on two numbers: the size of your team and the number of jobs you book a month. All prices below come from ServiceM8 pricing and Jobber pricing, both re-checked on 2026-11-18. Anything a vendor doesn't publish is marked unknown.

{{table:servicem8,jobber}}

Plans and prices

  • ServiceM8 (monthly price, no annual discount listed): Free $0 for 1 user and 30 jobs a month. Starter $29/mo, 50 jobs. Growing $79/mo, 150 jobs. Premium $149/mo, 500 jobs. Premium Plus $349/mo, 1,500+ jobs. Every paid plan has unlimited users. The 14-day trial needs no credit card, and there's no lock-in contract.
  • Jobber (billed annually / monthly with a 1-year commitment / no commitment): Core $29 / $39 / $49 for 1 user. Connect $99 / $119 / $139 for 1 user, with 5 users at $149 annually ($199 no commitment) and 10 users at $229 ($299). Grow $149 / $169 / $199 for 1 user, with 5 users at $229 ($299). Plus $399 / $439 / $499 with 5 users included. Extra users are $29/mo each. The 14-day trial runs on Grow and needs no credit card.

How ServiceM8 job credits work

ServiceM8's FAQ says every new job card uses one job credit. A job can start as a quote; if the client accepts and you switch it to a work order, it doesn't use a second credit. If you go over your plan's limit, you can keep creating jobs for another 7 days. If your monthly allowance resets in that window, you carry on; otherwise ServiceM8 prompts you to upgrade. On the Free plan, ServiceM8 says you can earn unlimited bonus jobs by accepting card payments through it.

Route businesses, count your visits. Recurring jobs are on all ServiceM8 plans and re-create themselves on a schedule. The pricing page doesn't say whether each repeat visit uses a job credit, so ask ServiceM8 before you sign up. If every visit counts, 40 weekly lawn or pool customers come to roughly 170 visits a month, which is past Growing (150) and into Premium ($149/mo).

What each one costs at your size

Simple arithmetic from the published list prices, before card fees and add-ons. Jobber prices shown billed annually, with the no-commitment monthly price in brackets.

Your businessServiceM8Jobber
Solo, under 30 jobs/moFree, $0/moCore $29/mo ($49)
Solo, 31-50 jobs/moStarter $29/moCore $29/mo ($49)
3 people, up to 150 jobs/moGrowing $79/moCore + 2 users $87/mo ($107); Connect 5-user $149/mo ($199) if you need routing or QuickBooks
5 people, up to 500 jobs/moPremium $149/moConnect 5-user $149/mo ($199); Grow 5-user $229/mo ($299)
10 people, over 500 jobs/moPremium Plus $349/moConnect 10-user $229/mo ($299); Grow 10-user $299/mo ($399)

The pattern: ServiceM8 is cheapest for small teams with low job counts, and it never charges more for adding a person. Jobber gets relatively cheaper once you book lots of jobs with a fixed crew, because its published prices don't change with job count. Jobber's annual prices are also prepaid and non-refundable, so compare its no-commitment price if you want to be able to leave month to month, as you can with ServiceM8.

Where the features sit

FeatureServiceM8Jobber
Users1 on Free; unlimited on every paid plan1 on Core, Connect and Grow (extra users $29/mo); 5 on Plus
Scheduling, quotes, invoices, email and SMSAll plans (pricing FAQ: "every ServiceM8 plan includes all the essentials")All plans
RoutingDispatch map and Auto Routing listed; the minimum plan for Auto Routing isn't clearly statedRoute optimization and GPS tracking on Connect and up; not on Core
Accounting syncQuickBooks Online, Xero and MYOB on all plansQuickBooks Online and Xero on Connect and up
Recurring jobsAll plansunknown by plan (the pricing page mentions automatic card charging for recurring work, US and Canada)
Online bookingAll plansYes
Offline use in the appOffline Access listed: the app works without signal and syncs laterJobber product update: keep working on jobs without internet (see field apps compared)
Custom forms and asset trackingElectronic Forms and Asset Management listed as Growing add-ons; pre-made forms from the Form Store can be bought on any planunknown (not listed this way on the pricing page)

Card payment fees

  • ServiceM8 Pay (US): 3.05% + 30¢ for standard domestic cards (US-issued Amex included) and 4.60% + 30¢ for international cards. Payouts arrive the next business day at no extra cost. ServiceM8's help center lists these US rates as current as of September 2024.
  • Jobber: 2.9% + 30¢ online, 2.7% + 30¢ with Tap to Pay, 1% for ACH bank payments. Instant payouts cost an extra 1%.

Example: on $10,000 a month of online card payments across 50 invoices, ServiceM8 Pay's fee is about $320 ($305 + $15) and Jobber's is about $305 ($290 + $15). That's a $15 a month gap, which can cancel out ServiceM8's lower subscription at higher volumes.

Which should you pick?

  • Solo, low volume, or testing the waters: ServiceM8 Free covers 30 jobs a month for $0. See all the free field service software we track.
  • Growing crew with a moderate number of jobs: ServiceM8. Adding a technician costs nothing extra on any paid plan.
  • Recurring routes with many visits a month (lawn, pool, window rounds): Jobber is usually easier to predict, because its pricing page lists no cap on jobs or visits. Check how ServiceM8 counts recurring visits first. {{aff:jobber|See Jobber plans}}
  • Lots of card payments: Jobber's 2.9% + 30¢ online rate is lower than ServiceM8 Pay's 3.05% + 30¢, and it offers 1% ACH.

Accounting: ServiceM8 sends invoices to QuickBooks Online and syncs payments both ways on every plan; Jobber pushes one way from Connect. Details for 8 tools: field service software with QuickBooks integration.

faq: For small teams with few jobs, yes. ServiceM8 is free for 1 user and 30 jobs a month, and paid plans start at $29/mo with unlimited users. Jobber starts at $29/mo billed annually ($49/mo with no commitment) for 1 user, and extra users are $29/mo each. Jobber can cost less once you book hundreds of jobs a month with a fixed team, because its pricing page lists no job limit (servicem8.com/pricing and getjobber.com/pricing, checked 2026-11-18).

No. ServiceM8 prices by monthly job credits (50, 150, 500 or 1,500+ new jobs a month on paid plans), and every paid plan includes unlimited users. The Free plan is limited to 1 user and 30 jobs a month.
What happens if I go over my ServiceM8 job limit?

ServiceM8's pricing FAQ says you can keep creating jobs and working as normal for another 7 days. If your monthly plan resets in that time, your job credits reset; otherwise you're prompted to upgrade.
Does Jobber have a free plan?
No. Jobber has a 14-day free trial on the Grow plan with no credit card. Its lowest paid plan is Core at $29/mo billed annually or $49/mo with no commitment.
Which has lower card processing fees?
On published US rates, Jobber: 2.9% + 30¢ online and 2.7% + 30¢ with Tap to Pay. ServiceM8 Pay charges 3.05% + 30¢ for standard US cards (help center rates listed as current as of September 2024).
Yes. ServiceM8 syncs with QuickBooks Online, Xero and MYOB on all plans. Jobber syncs with QuickBooks Online and Xero on Connect ($99/mo billed annually) and up.
